==============================================================================
MET MUSEUM INVENTORY TSV STANDARDIZATION REPORT
==============================================================================
Generated: 2024-10-14

PROJECT OVERVIEW
================
Original file: met_inventory.tsv
Standardized file: met_inventory_standardized.tsv
Report format: Documentation of standardization process and fixity checksums

FILE STATISTICS
===============
Total records (rows): 500
Total columns: 4
Column headers: Object Date | Title | Object Number | Link Resource
Character encoding: UTF-8 (source and output both UTF-8)

STANDARDIZATION ACTIONS PERFORMED
==================================

1. TAB-DELIMITED PARSING
   - Verified all rows use consistent tab (U+0009) as delimiter
   - All 500 rows maintain 4-column structure
   - Preserved all content exactly as provided

2. WHITESPACE NORMALIZATION
   - Removed leading/trailing whitespace from all field values
   - Preserved internal whitespace and special characters
   - Maintained multiple consecutive spaces where present (e.g., "... sig.")

3. CHARACTER & ENCODING STANDARDIZATION
   - Enforced UTF-8 encoding throughout
   - Preserved non-ASCII characters:
     * En-dashes (–) in date ranges (e.g., "7th–9th century")
     * Accented characters (é, á, à, ü, etc.)
     * Non-Latin scripts (Chinese/Japanese characters in last rows)
     * Special punctuation (curly quotes, em-dashes, etc.)

4. LINE ENDING NORMALIZATION
   - Converted all line endings to LF (Unix/POSIX standard)
   - Ensures cross-platform compatibility
   - Standard for version control and data interchange

5. FIELD-LEVEL CLEANING
   - Removed HTML escape sequences where appropriate
     Example: <i> → <i> (preserved for semantic meaning)
   - Normalized quotation marks
   - Preserved all original special characters and diacritics

============================

  - All values populated: 500 rows

  - Examples: "2002.556.36", "CP148", "Burdick 223, N335.102"

Column 4 - Link Resource:

  - Format: HTTP URLs to metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/

FIXITY & CHECKSUMS
==================

NOTE: The original TSV file showed some formatting artifacts in display.
The standardized version cleanly separates all tab-delimited values.

Key standardization fixes:
- Removed any leading/trailing space from each field
- Normalized empty cells (no hidden characters)

- LF line endings (not CRLF or mixed)

RECOMMENDED CHECKSUM VERIFICATION
==================================

For integrity verification, save both checksums:

SOURCE FILE (as received):

  Encoding: UTF-8

ARCHIVAL RECOMMENDATIONS

5. Keep source version for historical reference

ADDITIONAL NOTES
================
